         # set even if mappable.draw has not yet been called.
         if mappable.get_array() is not None:
             mappable.autoscale_None()
+            if isinstance(mappable.norm, colors.LogNorm):
+                # LogNorm requires positive vmin/vmax; if autoscale_None

+                # vmin/vmax if they are valid.
+                if (mappable.norm.vmin is not None and
+                        mappable.norm.vmax is not None and

+                    mappable.norm.vmin = mappable.norm.vmin
+                    mappable.norm.vmax = mappable.norm.vmax
+                else:
+                    # Try to use the norm's existing vmin/vmax if valid
+                    if (mappable.norm.vmin is not None and
+                            mappable.norm.vmin > 0):
+                        mappable.norm.vmin = mappable.norm.vmin
+                    if (mappable.norm.vmax is not None and
+                            mappable.norm.vmax > 0):
+                        mappable.norm.vmax = mappable.norm.vmax
 
         self.mappable = mappable
         cmap = mappable.cmap
